key_concepts: Light is a form of energy that affects daily life
Sources of light are objects that give off light
Light sources can be natural or artificial
The Sun is a natural source of light
Light bulbs, candles, and flashlights are artificial light sources
Light enables us to see objects
In complete darkness, objects cannot be seen even with eyes open
Light spreads out in all directions from its source
A light ray is a straight path of light
Opaque objects block light and do not let it pass through
A shadow is a dark shape formed when an opaque object blocks light
